sources.snippet: SAM3DBody-cpp Standalone C++ inference engine for SAM-3D-Body — zero Python dependency at runtime. Takes a BGR image and produces per-person MHR body pose parameters, camera translation, and optionally full 3D mesh vertices + 70 body/hand keypoints, all via ONNX Runtime + ggml.
